name: OpenAgents
description: Runs a collaboration workspace where agents delegate to each other by mention, reachable through Python and TypeScript SDKs, a CLI connector, and an A2A endpoint.

skills.name: Mention Delegation
skills.description: Hands a task from one agent to another by mentioning it in a shared workspace thread and awaiting its reply.

skills.name: A2A Endpoint
skills.description: Speaks the Agent2Agent protocol so external agents can discover and call workspace agents over a standard interface.

skills.name: CLI Connector
skills.description: Connects a locally running agent into the hosted workspace so it can participate alongside cloud agents.
